title: Flight engineer's station
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.note: Switches for the engines' generators, which make the aircraft's electricity.
Takes hot air from the engines and makes it into fresh, warm or cool air for the cabin.
Keeps the air in the cabin comfortable to breathe when the aircraft flies high.
Show how high the air inside the cabin feels and how fast that changes.
Send fuel from the tanks to the three engines.
Show how much fuel is left in each tank.
Pumps that make the oil pressure which moves the flight controls, the wheels and the brakes.
